clock_waveform.CLK_source: Host-supplied bus clock — LCLK (LPC, 33 MHz), SCLK (SPI, up to 33 MHz), SCL (I2C, 400 kHz / 1 MHz).
clock_waveform.tpm_internal_clock: Vendor-defined ring oscillator; bounded only by per-command execution time published in TIS/PTP.
clock_waveform.sample_edge_spi_mode0: MOSI sampled on rising edge of SCLK, MISO driven on falling edge (CPOL=0, CPHA=0).

command_octet_waveform.octets_on_wire: Big-endian octet stream of the marshalled command.
command_octet_waveform.after_header: Handle area → optional authorizationSize + sessions → parameters.

response_octet_waveform.octets_on_wire: Big-endian octet stream of the marshalled response.
response_octet_waveform.after_header: Handle area (sometimes) → optional parameterSize + parameters → sessions.

fifo_handshake_waveform.host_action: Burst-write octets to TPM_DATA_FIFO; respect burstCount field
fifo_handshake_waveform.tpm_response: Expect=1 until last header octet then byte-count complete.
burstCount controls flow; dataAvail clears at last octet.

command_cancel_waveform.tpm_response: TPM may abort and return TPM_RC_CANCELED (not all commands cancellable).

per_command_execution_time_rule: TPM2.0 commands have widely varying execution times — TPM2_GetRandom is microseconds; TPM2_Create with RSA-2048 may be seconds. Host shall poll TPM_STS.dataAvail rather than rely on a fixed wait. Maximum bounds are vendor-specific (typical 30 s for RSA-3072 key generation).
